title: TDOA Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TDOA_Estimator.md
text: Estimate time-difference of arrival, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Inherit sample rate}, {Signal sample rate (Hz)} sets the signal sampling rate, {Maximum number of TDOA estimates}, {Enable known delay offset input}, {Output variance of TDOA Estimates}, {Output TDOA response and TDOA grid}, {Source of noise power}, {Noise power (W)} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input data N -by- M -by- L complex-valued array

ports.name: DelayOffset
ports.summary: Delay offset (sec) scalar | 1-by- L real-valued vector

ports.name: Npow
ports.summary: Input noise power (W) positive scalar | 1-by- L vector of positive values

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: TDOA estimates (sec) K -by-( L -1) real-valued matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Estimated TDOA variance 1-by-( L -1) positive-value vector

ports.name: TDOAResp
ports.summary: TDOA response P -by- M -by-( L -1) MATLAB ® array

ports.name: TDOAGrid
ports.summary: TDOA grid real-valued P -by-( L -1) matrix

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: Inherit sample rate from upstream blocks on (default) | off

params.name: Signal sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Signal sampling rate 1000000 (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Maximum number of TDOA estimates
params.values: Maximum number of TDOA estimates 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable known delay offset input
params.values: Enable known delay offset input false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Output variance of TDOA Estimates
params.values: Output variance of TDOA estimates false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Output TDOA response and TDOA grid
params.values: Output TDOA response and TDOA grid false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Source of noise power
params.values: Source of noise power Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
